Messages.Author: Old_Spirit

Hello everyone,

I am new around here, didn't find an introduction thread, so here I am with my first post.

It's quite a few year I would like to go back play VTES.
I am trying to get my hands back in my old collection, but I am not sure if i'll succeed.

Meanwhile I was wondering what's the price of each complete set, and where to buy them, since I could not find any online so far.

I am looking for singles and not "playset" since it's for collection only. Unluckily there's no community in my area. I will play mainly online if I find someone in Lackey willing to teach me back and with some patience .

Thanks in advance for your time and help.
